necessarySourceFindings.finding: The reader accepts only the four originally observed/closed M4 cases, preserves the Native overall partial label, requires the exact normal recovery and wx original journal, and derives aliases only from the last selected M4 admission set. Later failed M5 cases are not converted into M4 coverage.

Source bytes are read and rehashed from the captured content-addressed storedFile, not from an assumed-current runtime tree. Initial107 all rows/all columns and every selected before/after frame, original baseline digest, table/column/PK shape and outsideScope zero are required. Complete observed versions remain the projection unit.

The complete original K wrapper/rebuild input/SQL plan is replayed and matched. Each explicit INSERT literal, the sole baseline back-pointer UPDATE, whole direct cohort, sourcePlanId, actual COMMIT or committed recovery, xmin and independent visible captures are checked. Only actual backend catalog DEFAULT now() created/updated sites receive bounded source-clock markers. Fixed dates, nulls and exact decimal literals retain value semantics.

The six complete direct-cohort/journal validation bodies are explicitly bridged and revalidated from the actual capsule. Historical helper harness pins are not described as current fixture pins. Current whole-cohort and ordinary typed proofs remain separate prerequisites. The readiness logical UUID is restricted to its one exact row/top-level column; no global UUID or ownership alias is granted.

Births require exact actual request context; chronological mutations require the preceding actual writer or a recorded committed fixture mutation. Attachment and link clocks must equal the actual uploaded session value and are verified before projection. Typed DTO dates use the original millisecond projection of the selected complete physical version. Provider before/after audit snapshots are replayed with the original constructor and exact request-adjacent physical rows.

Run-specific text is mapped only after complete original constructor/formatter replay or exact path/name/source payload verification. Complete bytes, length and SHA are checked before named payload slots. No generic run8, compact UUID, At-suffix, token or arbitrary digest replacement is introduced.

Previously reviewed finite AES and ZIP/logical helpers are reused with current derived bytes. Keys are read only by Root through the fixed new-c01 managed loader. The one OBS presigned target requires exact parameter set, encoded typed path, expiry/source clock, full HMAC and actual peer payload/canonical request evidence. The complete mature STORE manifest/entries/CRC/header layout/DOS buckets and exact microsecond TTL are verified before source-specific projections.

Complete retained HTTP bytes/length/hash/JSON are checked, actual method/path/index/backend must match fixed metadata, and status/full entity/four frozen functional headers are compared. R1A addition stays explicit. Failed required proof retains an original private diagnostic and a failed public result. Analysis sources are pinned before and after; no actual parity is inferred from pure tests.
